mapper.select: SELECT P.POLICY_ID, P.POLICY_NAME, P.POLICY_ORGANIZATION_NAME, P.POLICY_LARGE_CATEGORY, P.POLICY_DESCRIPTION, P.POLICY_APPLY_PERIOD_CODE, P.POLICY_APPLY_END_DATE FROM TBL_BOOKMARK B JOIN TBL_POLICY P ON P.POLICY_ID = B.POLICY_ID WHERE B.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC
